syllabus_topics: Principles and basic methods of mechanical testing of materials at static, dynamic and cyclic loading
Backgrounds of structure, properties and application of contemporary nonmetalic materials: plastics, sintered materials, ceramics and composites
Processes and basic technological methods of manufacturing products made of these materials
Principles, application fields and recent development of rapid prototyping
assessment_rules: During the semester three tests are considered as continuous control, the results are rated by a score system and they are taken into account at the final exam. The final exam is written, and if the total result from the control tests is at least good, it may be recognized as a final one.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
